description.value:
Pierces concrete like cardboard. Be careful with this beast.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load custom high-penetration tungsten ammunition (50eb [Costly] per round), which can only be used by this weapon and whenever they would ablate armor, ablate 2 additional SP. This weapon’s Tech Rebuild is capable of seeing simple target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover.

This weapon can see and fire through Thin and Thick Cover while uncharged and charged, but does not halve SP until its Tech Rebuild is charged. While charged and being used to make an Aimed Shot, this weapon deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6).

Additionally, while charged, there is no limit to the amount of walls or pieces of cover this weapon can fire through — this means it can effectively fire through a small building. However, its Tech Rebuild can only see simple target outlines through up to two layers of Thin Cover or one layer of Thick Cover, necessitating some other form of vision to fire at a target that is behind further layers. Whenever this weapon fires through a piece of Cover, it can perform Power Rebuild Ricochet Attacks that bounce off surfaces beyond the penetrated Cover.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
